camel_example: aliyun iot RefreshStudioAppTokenOpen --region cn-hangzhou --AppId a12000000 --ProjectId a1230000000
description_en: Refreshes the authentication token of an application
description_zh: 调用该接口刷新应用鉴权Token
kebab_example: aliyun iot refresh-studio-app-token-open --app-id a12000000 --project-id a1230000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefreshStudioAppTokenOpen

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216816.html to query the ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
Log on to the IoT Studio console (https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
In the list of common projects, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the ID in the address bar
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
您可登录物联网应用开发控制台 (https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看
parameters.name: project_id
